name: flappy
description: Flappy Wyzuk is a high-octane, modern indie browser game engineered from scratch with vanilla web technologies. Featuring glassmorphism aesthetics, futuristic neon UI, 12 customizable bird aviators, 11 dynamic parallax worlds, dynamic weather systems, Web Audio API procedural synthesis.

paragraphs: Flappy Wyzuk is a high-octane, modern indie browser game engineered from scratch with vanilla web technologies. Featuring glassmorphism aesthetics, futuristic neon UI, 12 customizable bird aviators, 11 dynamic parallax worlds, dynamic weather systems, Web Audio API procedural synthesis, and buttery smooth 60+ FPS performance.
🌐 Play Live Online (flpybrd.netlify.app) • ✨ Key Features • 🕹️ Controls • 🎨 Bird Skins • 🌌 Parallax Worlds • 🛠️ Architecture • 👤 Credits
features: 💎 Futuristic Glassmorphism & Neon UI: Translucent blurred glass panels (backdrop-filter: blur(28px)), luminous neon glow borders, and floating ambient orbs.

🪽 12 Unique Procedural Aviators: Classic Gold, Cyber Cyan, Crimson Phoenix, Emerald Dragon, Vaporwave Neon, Shadow Stealth, Celestial Angel, Solar Flare, Sakura Blossom, Aurora Frost, Cosmic Void, and Retro 8-Bit.

🌌 11 Multi-Layered Parallax Worlds: Sunny Sky, Sunset Synthwave, Cyber City Night, Enchanted Forest, Alpine Aurora, Deep Ocean, Retro Pixel World, Cosmic Space, Rainy Cyberpunk, Winter Snowstorm, and Golden Desert.

🌦️ Dynamic Particle & Weather Systems: Real-time falling rain streaks, fluffy snowflakes, floating fireflies, water bubble streams, engine flame trails, scoring bursts, impact explosions, and celebratory confetti.

🎵 Real-Time Procedural Synthesizer: Powered 100% by the Web Audio API—zero audio file loading latency. Includes frequency-swept jump chirps, harmonic coin chimes, low-pass impact thuds, and dynamic ambient synth pads.
